defaultPrompt: Check this MarketPinPredictor session and explain whether it is healthy.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only operations and review companion for MarketPinPredictor repositories. It helps inspect live Databento, FastAPI, Streamlit, audit, and SQLite evidence; reconcile questionable gamma and prediction values; review dashboard trust, signal explanations, and financial-risk communication; and run narrowly scoped repository quality checks. It defaults to read-only evidence gathering, preserves invalid and stale states, never treats analytical targets as guaranteed outcomes, and does not place trades or automatically restart services.
